title: Finite Tor dimension on a scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ an object of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $E$ has finite Tor dimension if there exist integers $a\le b$ such that for every sheaf $F$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and every integer $i<a$ or $i>b$, $H^i(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}F)=0$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes].
